profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Improving
profile.summary: I bring a unique combination of analytical strength honed from doctoral training in philology, history, and philosophy, with broad experience in software development, architecture, DevOps, and departmental leadership. Beyond this, I am a community leader in the companies I have worked for, organizing continuing education, communication, and process development.
